+def _quota_intervals(data):
+    jobs = data["jobs"]
+    k = data["k"]
+    blocked = set(data.get("blocked", []))
+    mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+    quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+    best_value = None
+    best_ids = None
+    n = len(jobs)
+    for mask in range(1 << n):
+        if mask.bit_count() != k:
+            continue
+        chosen = [jobs[i] for i in range(n) if mask >> i & 1]
+        ids = {job["id"] for job in chosen}
+        if ids & blocked or not mandatory <= ids:
+            continue
+        counts = {}
+        for job in chosen:
+            counts[job["group"]] = counts.get(job["group"], 0) + 1
+        if any(not low <= counts.get(group, 0) <= high
+               for group, (low, high) in quotas.items()):
+            continue
+        ordered = sorted(chosen, key=lambda j: (j["start"], j["end"]))
+        if any(a["end"] > b["start"]
+               for i, a in enumerate(ordered) for b in ordered[i + 1:]):
+            continue
+        value = sum(job["value"] for job in chosen)
+        id_list = tuple(sorted(ids))
+        if (best_value is None or value > best_value or
+                (value == best_value and id_list > best_ids)):
+            best_value, best_ids = value, id_list
+    if best_value is None:
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+    return {"selected": list(best_ids), "value": best_value}
+
